title: Research: present-head flag 1 reaches target span only after its last update (no new kappa)
body:
## Change and scope

One-flag follow-up under priority revision 6, card `p104-side-correction`. [#3349](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3349) names present-head class `(0,1,9,43)`. [#3392](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3392) pins absent-head flag 2. [#3443](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3443) pins present-head flag 9 late hosting. This package pins flag 1 (`X0` → `Y7`, basis head `232`) with both literal-frame and GF(2)-span chronology.

On the published 4,058-event word:

- the head enters `Y7` (listed and in span) only at the terminal transport after-frame at event 3473
- all six `Y7` adds (last at event 2797) run in head-free charts (`head_free_target_updates=6/6`)
- `X0`'s literal drop at event 591 is a nested chart change that keeps `232` in span (`8 ^ 32 ^ 64 ^ 128`); `source_span_drops=0`
- `preterminal_hosting=0` and `preterminal_span_hosting=0`; zero joint endpoint events; frames unrestored

Chronological dirty restoration therefore cannot use co-hosted basis-head geometry on this word. Flag 1 is not a reprint of flag 9 (drop/arrive/gap 591/3473/2882 vs 500/3489/2989; different target/head/frames).

**Scoped obstruction. No new kappa.** Selected κ stays 0.001672660197076918. Coefficient delivery (flag-0 cascade on `Y34`) is outside this package.

## Result

Package: `research/p104-present-head-flag1-audit/`.
Tip: `818c303a9740b8704bbb0dfd06fb42af28b06c69`.
Content tip: `112436d9be29b668c9306901843c440dafac3755`.
Base: `6f100d4bb5083f8c35d96fd95a539811c62f245c`.

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/p104-present-head-flag1-audit/verify.py
python3.12 -I -O -Werror -B research/p104-present-head-flag1-audit/verify.py
python3.12 -I -O -Werror -B research/p104-present-head-flag1-audit/independent.py
python3.12 -I -O -Werror -B research/p104-present-head-flag1-audit/test_package.py
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-present-head-flag1-audit
```

Expected:

```text
PASS_P104_PRESENT_HEAD_FLAG1 flag=1 head=232 preterminal_hosting=0 preterminal_span_hosting=0 drop_event=591 arrive_event=3473 source_span_drops=0 head_free_target_updates=6/6 no_new_kappa
PASS_P104_PRESENT_HEAD_FLAG1_INDEPENDENT flag=1 head=232 preterminal_hosting=0 preterminal_span_hosting=0 drop_event=591 arrive_event=3473 source_span_drops=0 head_free_target_updates=6/6 no_new_kappa
PASS_P104_PRESENT_HEAD_FLAG1_TESTS groups=6
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/p104-present-head-flag1-audit outcome=completed
```

Default verify is read-only. Admission uses `need()` and still fires under `-O`.

## Overlap and credit

Closest priors: [#3443](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3443) (flag 9 method), [#3349](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3349) (present-head census), [#3392](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3392) (absent-head flag 2), merged [#3242](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3242) (`X0` first touched at 591). Does not reopen those packages, #3441/#3436/#3421/#3411, deferred V45/rho=0, or the merged readout series through #2883. Soft-overlap checked against open #3363/#3365/#3371/#3372 (coefficient delivery on flag 0 / `Y34`): this package recomputes no coefficient and says nothing about `Y34`.
